parsed.summary: The change addresses the issue by modifying the URL format for the password reset link, but it may introduce a regression risk.

issues.description: The change assumes that the UserAdmin is always accessed via its primary key, which may not be true in all cases. This could lead to incorrect URLs in other scenarios.
